milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must be within viewing distance (max_distance=16) of the spruce planks cabin center at spawn-relative [5, 2, 7] and face toward it (facing_tolerance=60°), modeling that the player has visually identified the spruce planks structure. max_distance=16 is appropriate because 'finding' means visual identification, not physical contact — the agent demonstrates success by looking toward the correct structure.
